catalogTitle: SKYCOIN4444 Mission Control Engineering Beta Surface

statusVocabulary.available_in_beta: Deployed, release-approved, and verified in the current beta environment.
statusVocabulary.engineering_beta: Verified first-party source-control or CI integration without independently verified external-provider operation.
statusVocabulary.planned: Represented in the product direction but unavailable to testers.
statusVocabulary.unavailable: Excluded from the current beta or blocked by unverified dependencies.

betaJourney.name: Mission Control discovery and one verified non-financial workflow
steps: Review the capability catalog and availability labels.
Sign in only when the deployed authentication and session path is verified.
Use a profile only when deployed persistence, consent, and privacy controls are verified.
Complete one approved non-financial course or creator workflow.
Submit feedback through the monitored beta support route.

capabilities.name: Mission Control discovery
requirements: The deployed route passes a release-environment smoke test.
Every displayed capability has a current catalog status.
Unavailable capabilities cannot be mistaken for provider-backed services.

capabilities.name: Account and profile
requirements: Authentication and session configuration are independently verified in the beta environment.
Persistence, consent, privacy notice, deletion/support path, and failure behavior are verified before promotion to available_in_beta.

capabilities.name: Curated course or creator workflow
requirements: One specific workflow is selected and named in the release record.
The end-to-end path has automated and release-environment smoke-test evidence.
The workflow does not require any excluded financial, custody, or unverified provider operation.

capabilities.name: Feedback and support intake
requirements: A monitored feedback destination and triage owner are recorded in the release record.
Security-sensitive reports follow SECURITY.md rather than a public feedback channel.

capabilities.name: Financial, custody, and live Web3 operations
requirements: Separate security, operational, provider, legal, and release evidence is required before any public exposure.

capabilities.name: External provider integrations

packages: provider adapters and configured server integrations

requirements: Each provider must be configured, least-privilege reviewed, tested for success and failure behavior, monitored, and separately release-approved.

excludedCategories: unverified AI, cloud, messaging, storage, analytics, OAuth, or blockchain-provider operation
